prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

Customer: Off to Vegas this early morning - brought drinks and food for our flight crew who are serving us!  1729 cvg to Las https://t.co/q35sUbMTGT
Delta: Thank you for kindness, Father Jim. Have a wonderful day! *AMR

Customer: 🛫 X #KeepClimbing X #Seattle X seahawks  X  🎥🎞🎥 is on the move X… https://t.co/ELc5qHUR4o
Delta: Nice to have you on board. Have a great flight:-) *HPL

Customer: Straight up. ’s customer service is why I will always fly with them. They literally ALWAYS take care of me
Delta: Hey Beau, thanks for reaching out. When you need us just tweet us. Have a great week. 😊 *TBT

Customer: Let's do this. Off to work...#workingontheweekend #deltamakesiteasier

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: social_chitchat):
"""Flying to Seattle from Las Vegas onboard  DL144. Was napping so I can go straight to work after arriving. I'm an oncology nurse."""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thank you for all you do, and safe travels to Seattle! ✈️ Have a smooth flight and a great shift ahead.
